description: Placeholder and role-name traps plus a company in a team-like context. An unnamed speaker header ('Unnamed facilitator'), a job title used as a name ('the recruiter' / 'Recruiter'), a generic group ('Partners'), and 'Anthropic's partner team' — Anthropic is an external organization (account), never a team. Also an accented participant name (Tomás Herrera) for id folding.

meeting.transcript:
**Unnamed facilitator**: Welcome back, cohort. Quick round of updates before we get into the partner program questions.
**Priya Raman**: Sure. The big news is Northwind Logistics signed. We're scoping Relay with them now — Relay is the dispatch automation build, first milestone is the carrier-rate import in three weeks.
**Tomás Herrera**: Congrats. On my side, the recruiter came back again about that fractional role. Recruiter said they want someone who can run an AI program, but honestly I'd rather keep consulting.
**Unnamed facilitator**: Did anyone apply to the partner tier yet?
**Priya Raman**: We did. Anthropic's partner team reviewed the application last week and asked for two customer references. Partners at that tier get co-selling support, apparently.
**Tomás Herrera**: I heard the Partners channel is where they post the tier changes. I'm going to submit once Relay has a case study.
**Priya Raman**: Makes sense. I'll send you the Northwind reference template tomorrow.
**Unnamed facilitator**: Great. Same time next week, everyone.
